Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 9, 2026

1. Information We Collect

We collect information you provide directly to us when you book an appointment, contact our salon, or connect with us on social media. This may include your name, phone number, email address, and service preferences.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the collected information solely to schedule appointments, send appointment confirmations or reminders, respond to inquiries, and inform you of promotions or updates regarding Sidney Nails.

3. Sharing of Information

We respect your privacy and never sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We only share details with trusted service providers necessary to operate our booking or messaging systems, or as required by applicable law.

4. Contact Us

If you have any questions or requests regarding your personal information, please call Sidney Nails directly at (406) 433-5555 or visit us at 422 N Central Ave, Sidney, MT 59270.
